## Purpose
`/ontology`: the Catalog hub. Its views cover the overview, the vocabulary, annotations, knowledge, scope, query, RAG (libraries and graph) and retrieval. The current view is kept in the URL, so a refresh or a shared link lands in the same place.

## Responsibilities
- `OntologyPage` validates the view search parameter and reads `ontologyApi.overview`.
- `OntologyHub` shows the feature cards; `FeatureBanner` and `ActiveView` render the chosen tab.
- The tabs: OverviewTab, VocabularyTab, AnnotationsTab, KnowledgeTab, ScopeTab, QueryTab, RagTab and RetrievalTab.
- `graphTones` supplies the colours.
- Titled "Catalog — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`OntologyPage`, `OntologyHub`.

## Control flow
Search-parameter driven view switching.

## Data, state and side effects
None.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Backend:** `/api/ontology/*` and `/api/rag/*`.

## Error handling and edge cases
- ErrorState.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **The graph spans the whole platform,** not just the vocabulary, so it stands alone.
- **Rows always fill the width:** three across only when there are three.
